notes.title: Resolution selection patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where it wasn't showing all possible resolutions. Also some minor updates to the Castle Level design.

notes.title: Fairly impactful update
notes.content:
Hopefully there are no issues 🤞. Changed the way the levels work in the menu which required a lot of foundational changes. Also can see all the levels now even the sort of intermission levels. Still need to make it look nicer that will come soon. 

Biggest change is probably in the physics, Anna now builds up speed as she runs, some felt the movement seemed slow and hopefully this will change how that feels quite a bit.  Also changed some of the dampening happening on the grapple mechanic which should make her feel more springy there as well. There will probably be some level design issues, I tried to fix the ones I saw but you can get to places you couldn't before so I am sure some will come up.

Let me know if you have any feedback, thank you

notes.title: Minor performance adjustments
notes.content: Changed some of the rendering loops to be more efficient.

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content: fixed an issue in the start scene not loading

notes.title: QOL improvements
notes.content:
Castle Scene redone with new graphics and slightly different mechanics
Added more prompts for scenes and items that might need explaining
Changed the Dash to be more responsive to input
Added some visual elements to almost all the scenes

Let me know if there are any issues or suggestions

notes.title: More bow highlight additions, graphical changes
notes.content: Changed the bow aiming line to change colors when it has a target locked on, it goes from blue to red to show that it will hit. Also added a more pronounced highlight around the target that it is locked on to. Some graphical changes throughout the game, and performance improvements

notes.title: Bow aiming visibility, timed leaderboards update
notes.content: Changed the way the line for aiming looks to stand out more  based on feedback. Some quality of life updates for the Timed Leaderboard levels, graphically and how it plays

notes.title: More in game dialogs for instruction and some graphics changes
notes.content: Added some more in game dialogs for instruction. Also some graphics changes to the level you get the bow. Also some minor code optimization for the trail left from shooting the arrow.

notes.title: General game information dialogs
notes.content: Added some more in game dialogs to explain better what needs to be done. Mostly in the start scene.

notes.title: Update for Tutorials/SteamDeck
notes.content: Updated the tutorials to hopefully make text easier to read on the SteamDeck

notes.title: bug fix for menu
notes.content: fixed an issue with changing resolution making the selection orb move offscreen

notes.title: Small patch to fix a Dialog Prompt issue
notes.content: Small patch to fix a dialog prompt button from going away when you leave the area to trigger it

notes.title: Small patch for ui updates
notes.content: Made the dialog items have a little more room on the bottom for TV's with slight overscan. Changed the dialog/information when you first get Double Jump to make it feel better, hopefully.

notes.title: Learderboard api update
notes.content: Update to the Leaderboard API code

notes.title: Small update for shader fixes
notes.content: Just a small update for shader fixes found with last patch on some devices. Let me know if you come across any other issues

notes.title: Added player health system
notes.content: Added a player health system so not everything kills you instantly : )

notes.title: Modified some mechanics on the final stage, and some bug fixes
notes.content:
- fixed a bug where the Arrows would push the moving platforms if shot.
- Fixed a bug where the Plant Dragon would shoot fire before the mechanic is activated
- Changed the color of the platform in the AI Boss room for accessibility reasons
- In the final stage some mechanics were added to make the gameplay feel more fluid and also make the concept of the mechanics more accessible
- Fixed some graphical bugs in the Time Trial level

notes.title: Minor update, collision fixes
notes.content:
This update adds a check for collisions on objects that can be bounced off of while swinging such as the bats at the beginning of the game. So if you hit an object like a bat while swinging as long as it is on top of it, it will bounce instead of kill the player now.

I also fixed an area right before you got to the jewel puzzle to where you could die hitting the wall. Let me know if you have any issues, I can usually fix them fairly quick.

notes.title: Lighting changes for the second to last Level and bug fix
notes.content: Changed some of the lighting in the second to last Level to make the character separation a bit more pronounced. Fixed a bug with the fish spawning at the troll pond, that would probably never be seen but just in case. Let me know if you come across any issues

notes.title: Patch to fix Steamworks issue with disconnects
notes.content: Hopefully fixed the issue with Steamworks disconnecting. Let me know if there are still issues or other questions

notes.title: Patch for Timed Level to highlight items
notes.content: Some more highlight changes, mostly on the Timed Level

notes.title: More lighting and highlight changes
notes.content: Added a highlight to the player in scenes where it might not stand out enough. Changed the lighting in the level where you get the bow. Other minor fixes involving text and motion blur

notes.title: Added highlights for some of the enemies to better see danger
notes.content: Added highlights to some of the enemies to better show where danger is. Some other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Minor collision bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a collision bug in the Timed Leaderboard scene

notes.title: Added some vibration to the Controller. You can turn it off in the Pause menu
notes.content: Added some vibration for the character movements to the controller. You can turn it off in the pause menu of the game. Also changed the camera angle/view in the castle/dungeon to better show the fireballs coming from underneath. Please let me know of any issues with this build

notes.title: More hints both text and graphical. Added pause menu to opening
notes.content: Added more hints, both text and graphical. Added a pause menu to the opening scene.

notes.content: Changed some of the layout for the initial maze level and made the camera angle point slightly down to better see the ground while playing based on feedback.
